programs.title: Ocean with David Attenborough
programs.desc: Renowned British naturalist Sir David Attenborough recently celebrated his 99th birthday.For several decades, he has been popularizing knowledge about the Blue Planet and drawing attention to the need to protect disappearing worlds.Oceans have a special place in his mission.In the document, which is a visual feast, it presents unusual forms of life hidden in the depths inaccessible to humans.Using new filming technologies, it takes viewers to amazing places.Warns against the threats related to climate change.It also shows how fishing devastates aquatic ecosystems.However, his message is not without hope.

programs.title: The Soviet Union
programs.desc: The USSR was established 100 years ago - on December 30, 1922.The filmmakers present archival materials that help answer the question of what fueled the Soviet empire throughout the 20th century.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigation
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of famous plane crashes.Viewers will see a reconstruction of the events that led to the tragedy.Fictionalized stories are complemented by accounts of pilots, experts, and witnesses..
